title: Signature prompt sentinels and probabilistic gating for shadowed rollouts
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Current canary/AB/shadow workflows rely on static, monolithic golden sets and rigid thresholds which generate noisy alerts or miss subtle regressions. Goal: Build a lightweight, extensible system of 'signature prompt sentinels' (small, semantically diverse prompt subsets) and a probabilistic, multi-metric gating engine that can be applied to canary, A/B, and shadow traffic to reduce false positives, catch regressions earlier, and allow safe automatic rollback.

Scope:
- Define sentinel format and metadata (tags, expected distribution, severity).
- Implement scorecard evaluators (semantic similarity, toxicity, hallucination heuristics, latency, token cost).
- Add Bayesian/probabilistic thresholding to decide when metric shifts warrant an alarm or auto-rollback rather than strict deterministic rules.
- Expose per-customer sentinel uploads and per-deployment scorecard config in Console.
- Integrate into rollout orchestrator so shadow traffic can trigger pre-emptive warnings without affecting live traffic.

Non-goals: full dataset-level drift detector (this ticket focuses on sentinel-based gates); end-to-end UI polish (Console surface will start as an advanced settings panel).
comments: 2025-02-18 - Kickoff: aligned on sentinel definition. Action: product to provide 3 canonical sentinel sets: 'safety', 'factuality', 'formatting' (PM: Nora Patel).

2025-02-21 - Eng design review: decided to use a lightweight JSONL sentinel artifact with example outputs + expected matcher. Avoided building a new DSL to keep iteration fast. (Design feedback from Mei Tran: prefer explicit failure reasons).

2025-02-28 - Prototype: implemented scorecard pipeline on shadow traffic in staging for 12h. Observed 2x reduction in alerts vs existing golden-set gate by adding a likelihood model and occupancy correction for short prompts. Recording: https://dashboard.redwood.ai/runs/eng/61234/staging-20250228
2025-03-02 - PM review: agreed on probabilistic rollback policy tiers: warn -> throttle canary -> automated rollback. Added customer_notify flag for high-severity failures. (PM: Nora Patel approved).
2025-03-04 - Security review requested (partial): need to confirm that per-customer sentinel uploads do not expose PII in logs. (Security: flagged to infra for KMS encryption in transit).
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel artifact spec published to Confluence and validated by PM and Design
Scorecard evaluator runs on shadow traffic end-to-end and emits structured signals to tracing/logs
Probabilistic gate supports configurable alpha and severity mapping and triggers orchestrator actions (warn/throttle/rollback)
Per-customer sentinel upload pipeline stores artifacts encrypted at rest and honors retention policies
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: too-sensitive sentinels will cause unnecessary rollbacks -> Mitigation: staged probation period and conservative default thresholds; require two independent metric drifts to auto-rollback.
Risk: customer-supplied sentinels may contain PII -> Mitigation: validate and scrub at ingest; surface explicit warning to customers and require agreement in Console.
Risk: increased compute for extra evals on shadow traffic -> Mitigation: sample shadow traffic and prioritize sentinel runs on representative buckets.
